content: Google Drive API returns 403 'User rate limit exceeded' and 429 'Rate limit exceeded'; mandatory exponential backoff. Per-project and per-user quotas exist (free). appDataFolder is hidden from the user and from other apps, counts against user quota, and is DELETED when the user uninstalls the app from My Drive (and is user-deletable). Implication: appDataFolder contradicts the 'you own and can see your data' promise and risks silent data loss on uninstall; prefer a visible named folder via drive.file.
